project: Across the Room: the far-side check

requirements.text: First launch explains phone mark, stationary phone, 2.5-3 m seat, TV as display, local processing, relative results with separate listener responses; remote-controlled start with visible focus
TV shows short room code and optional QR; phone opens HTTPS page and enters/receives code
TV confirms the intended phone before access (matching confirm digits); code is a locator only
Expired-code, rejected-join, connection-loss and retry states on both clients
Mic permission requested only after explicit phone action
Distinct states: waiting, denied, no mic, busy, unsupported constraints, active, stopped, unknown
Read actual track settings and supported constraints; never show Mic live before capture starts
Five-second quiet-room check then one calibration phrase from seat; per-session calibration default
Predeclared quality rule rejects unsuitable input with non-blaming next action; retry/cancel/skip
Optional sustained-vowel window <=30 s with elapsed timer, qualified relative feedback, measured voice-activity duration, early stop, skip, rest, immediate remote cancel; no max-effort instruction
Default ten original household phrases; household saves 1-10 phrases of 1-60 chars; trimmed Unicode, literal rendering
Manual advancement with OK; large relative-level arc during valid capture; invalid/interrupted windows unscored
Hidden meter at positions 3/6/9 when present; Felt loud/Felt normal/Skip rating; reveal after response phase
No hidden-result leak via arc, colour, labels, accessible labels, announcements, phone display, notifications
Only first attempt counts for hidden-meter; retries have unique IDs, show meter, distinguishable in summaries
Listener controls Heard/Not heard/Cue on the same phone, enabled only after capture closes
Cue 1-12 chars, max 3 per session enforced on both clients and authoritative TV state
Family mode holds verdict until listener responds or speaker skips/continues; hidden attempts also need rating; timeout never invents a response
Reveal locks the attempt; late responses marked late and excluded from primary denominator

Summary: completed/attempted/skipped/invalid separately; relative-band results; voice-activity duration; hidden-meter responses; eligible listener responses; agreement with denominator split hidden/visible
Seven-day dated history; missing days remain missing; seeded/fixture data visibly labelled; no incomplete-vs-complete silent comparison
Settings: positioning, supported devices/measurement mode, reset calibration, delete local data, unpair, about/version/licenses, developer diagnostics outside practice flow
Destructive actions confirm with Cancel focused by default; verify deletion and capture shutdown
No audio upload, saved recordings, cloud ASR, LLM scoring, clinical coaching, speaker ID, third listener phone
Not a medical device wording; no efficacy claims; relative level not SPL/comprehension/intelligibility/identity
React Native for Vega app on a single compatible SDK/RN/React/OS line with compatibility matrix
Official native Hello World proven before UI polish; vega project doctor and vpt validate with strict ABI
Manifest interactive component category com.amazon.category.main
Vega build toolchain isolated from supported GA Lambda runtime
Repository structure apps/tv, apps/phone, packages/protocol, packages/phone-mic-meter, packages/ten-foot-meter, services/relay/{local,aws}, infra, fixtures, tests, docs
Local relay with same protocol; trustworthy HTTPS for physical phone; LAN http never presented as mic origin; modes distinguished (physical, same-Mac, fixture)
No production polling fallback without separate ADR
Versioned schemas with full envelope binding fields
Typed messages for all listed commands/observations with sender direction rules
Pairing: short-lived code, cryptographic credentials, atomic role claims, rate limits, TV confirmation, role-bound expiry, revocation, safe reconnect
Browser WS auth via documented first-message auth; per-message authorization; exact Origin allowlist without blanket missing-Origin bypass
Reject unknown types, wrong direction, raw audio/PCM/binary/base64 blobs, non-finite, impossible durations, oversized, invalid ids, stale/closed-window, cross-room/session
Idempotent duplicate/replay handling; logical expiry on reads; handle GoneException, missed disconnects, connection lifetime, reconnect without invented results
Audio local and ephemeral; no MediaRecorder/uploads/persistence/ASR/analytics
Request AGC/EC/NS off; inspect supported constraints, settings, sample rate, track state; settings are not proof
Documented RMS/dBFS convention, epsilon floor, clipping; display smoothing separate from scoring
Defined and tested silence, non-finite, clipping, floor stability, VAD candidate/accepted/hangover, gaps, coverage, summaries, band boundaries
Actual capture timestamps; continuous local analysis adapter
Seven inherited design conflicts resolved explicitly (ADR-0001/2/8/9)
Bounded quiet precheck returns aggregate; level samples only during active valid windows; UI distinguishes Mic off/open not measuring/measuring/unknown
Shutdown on end/cancel/unpair/expiry/background: stop tracks, release Wake Lock, cancel timers/worklets, close AudioContext, clear buffers, acknowledge
Per-session relative calibration default; cross-session comparisons disabled
Frozen experiment protocol before trials; randomized repeats; negative cases; full recording fields; failures recorded
Listener Edition fallback within same product if evidence fails
Explicit state machines for TV session, phone mic, transport, listener/reveal with required stages

Every TV action remote reachable; conspicuous focus; Back/cancel during measurement; duplicate OK cannot double-start; reconnect needs fresh start; resume/discard never invents completion; text/shape plus colour
Supported Vega accessibility APIs; VoiceView order, UI scale, high contrast, announcements, modal focus, large phone controls, hidden-result leak tests
Spoken output coordinated before capture; never disable accessibility service
AsyncStorage unencrypted disclosed; minimized retention; credentials not persisted; verified deletion; migrations; crash resume
Versioned IaC with local/staging/production configs; least-privilege IAM; secrets outside repo/clients; exact CORS/origins; private S3 + CloudFront OAC + security headers
Bounded timeouts/retries; log redaction/retention; rate/concurrency controls; cost model; budget alerts; metrics; alarms+runbooks; rollback; recovery; tested disable procedure
Dependency/license inventory; artifact hashes/provenance; supported-device matrix; maintenance docs
Separate portable Linux CI from supported-host native Vega checks
Requirement-to-evidence matrix before readiness claims
Numerical, protocol/relay, browser, TV, end-to-end (local+AWS), fault, privacy/security and physical/operational tests as listed in master prompt §14
Evidence classes kept separate; frozen engineering targets with reviewer approval; every check recorded with full fields
Separate readiness fields engineering_release_candidate / hackathon_ready / public_production_ready / public_production_launched

Working Fire TV/Vega demo; public English video < 3 min; source + reproducible setup; license; description/architecture; limitations; work-in-window; tool feedback; genuine friction logs; track/challenge; judge access; AWS Builder evidence; optional OSS contribution
Recheck official rules before submission; maintain judge access through 21 Nov 2026 01:30 IST; no publishing/invitations/attestations without authorization
Lead claude-opus-5-5, teammates claude-sonnet-5-5 verified and reported; native team or documented limitation; independent review; worktrees or non-overlapping ownership
Durable .build files, loop, checkpoints, 3-attempt rule, no cancelled_optional for required work
